links.comparator_used: Zero-shot prompting without audience or reading-level specification (STANDARD)
links.outcome: Readability/difficulty level of ChatGPT-generated cervical cancer screening information in Polish (Jasnopis.pl)
links.effect: Mean difficulty 5.32 (at least 15 years of formal education) for STANDARD vs 4.15 (12 years of formal education) for EASY; 21 of 24 linguistic indicators showed statistically significant improvement (p < 0.05)
links.tradeoff: Readability remained too high for patients with only primary education despite the audience persona instruction
links.quote: While ChatGPT significantly simplified MICC_GPT, the readability levels remained too high for patients with only primary education.

links.comparator_used: Zero-shot prompting with no reading-level or audience instruction (STANDARD)
links.outcome: Readability of patient-facing ChatGPT cervical cancer screening information in Polish
links.effect: Average difficulty level 5.32 (at least 15 years of education) for STANDARD vs 4.15 (12 years of education) for EASY; 21 of 24 indicators significantly improved (p < 0.05)
links.tradeoff: Output still too difficult for patients with only primary education (8 years of schooling target not reached)
links.quote: The average difficulty level of STANDARD output was 5.32 (at least 15 years of formal education), while EASY output averaged 4.15 (12 years of formal education).
